recipe.name: Hollawall backend and browser acceptance
build: .venv/bin/python -m compileall -q agent_core dashboard_api handlers layers services utils scripts main.py sheets_helper.py
test: CHROMIUM_PATH=$(command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || command -v google-chrome || command -v google-chrome-stable) .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/browser -o addopts=''
